commands.ariba: ariba prepareref -f CATALOGUE -m METADATA DIR; ariba run --threads N DIR R1 R2 OUT
commands.copy-number: locus-recon-copy-number --bam full_map.sorted.bam (--locus ... --gene-span ...)... --gene-length BP --gfa assembly_graph_after_simplification.gfa --bait BAIT --output-json OUT --output-tsv OUT
commands.depth-ratio: locus-recon-depth-ratio --bam full_map.sorted.bam (--locus CONTIG:START-END --gene-span START-END)... --gene-length BP --tsv OUT
commands.kma: kma index -i CATALOGUE -o DB; kma -ipe R1 R2 -o OUT -t_db DB -t N
commands.locus-recon: locus-recon --samplesheet TSV --main-output-dir DIR --bait BAIT --locus NAME --threads N [--noncoding-locus]

parameters.copy_number_options: defaults; --locus and --gene-span from blast_step1.tsv; --gene-length; --gfa of the draft; --bait
